<fidel-quiz>

Quiz with a timer you control. Questions as fieldsets with real radio buttons or checkboxes, feedback in words, and an optional timer that can be extended or switched off.

Who it helps:ማንን ይረዳል፦ Learners who need more time, and screen-reader users (feedback in words, focus moves to it).

Live exampleየቀጥታ ምሳሌ

This example is live: try it with the keyboard, a mouse or touch, and a screen reader.ይህ ምሳሌ ቀጥታ ነው፦ በኪቦርድ፣ በማውዝ ወይም በንክኪ፣ እና በስክሪን አንባቢ ይሞክሩት።

Which tag is the main heading of a page?

  • <p>
  • <h1>
  • <a>

Which of these help a Deaf learner follow a video?

  • Captions
  • Louder sound
  • A transcript

Code to copyየሚቀዳ ኮድ

<fidel-quiz label="Check what you learned">
  <div data-question data-answer="1" data-explanation="&lt;h1&gt; is the main heading.">
    <p>Which tag is the main heading of a page?</p>
    <ul><li>&lt;p&gt;</li><li>&lt;h1&gt;</li><li>&lt;a&gt;</li></ul>
  </div>
</fidel-quiz>

Source: player/src/components/e/quiz.js

Attributesመለያዎች (attributes)

Attributes of <fidel-quiz>
AttributeValuesDefaultMeaning
questionsJSONnoneQuestions as [{"question","options","answer","explanation","ownWay"}]; or use child markup.
labeltextnoneTitle of the quiz.
time-limitsecondsnone (no time limit)Adds a timer with a warning 1 minute before the end, "Add 5 minutes" and "Switch the timer off".
heading-level2 to 63Level of the component's heading, so it fits your page's outline.
ui-langen, amthe page's lang, else enLanguage of the component's own buttons and messages.

Eventsክስተቶች (events)

Events sent by <fidel-quiz>
Eventevent.detailWhen
fidel-quiz-done{ score, total }Every question was answered.
fidel-quiz-own-answer{ question, kind, text | blob, mimeType }An "Answer in your own way" answer (not scored).

Events bubble and carry no personal data. Listen with addEventListener, like any DOM event.

Keyboard and screen readerኪቦርድ እና ስክሪን አንባቢ

  • Each question is a <fieldset> with a <legend>; arrow keys move between radio buttons.
  • "Check answer" shows "Correct." or "Not quite: the answer is …" next to the question and moves focus there.
  • The timer starts only when the learner enters the quiz.

Languagesቋንቋዎች

Its own buttons and messages are in English or Amharic. Set ui-lang="am" on the tag (or on a parent); without it, the page's lang is used, else English.

Accessibility and WCAGተደራሽነት እና WCAG

  • 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable: No time limit unless time-limit is set; then a warning, "Add 5 minutes" and "Switch the timer off".
  • 1.3.1 Info and Relationships: Fieldsets with legends and native radio buttons and checkboxes.
  • 2.4.3 Focus Order: Focus moves to the feedback after "Check answer".
  • 4.1.3 Status Messages: Score and the timer warning are announced.
  • Child markup: data-answer="1" (from 0); data-answer="0,2" means "choose all that apply" (checkboxes). data-own-way adds "Answer in your own way": writing, voice note or sign language, sent to the page, not scored.
